subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat app-auth DMs support an opt-in threaded mode, and should that be expressed as a new `dmThreadMode` key or folded into the existing `replyToMode` contract?
rationale: Source review can validate the narrow code path, but choosing a new persistent config surface and re-enabling a previously rejected DM thread target requires maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Decide config API first
options.body: Choose the accepted config surface before merge, then require the branch to update exported types, generated metadata, docs, and live proof for that shape.

options.title: Accept separate DM knob
options.body: Allow `dmThreadMode` as a documented Google Chat account key after the contract and real-behavior proof are complete.

options.title: Keep current DM policy
options.body: Decline this PR if maintainers want the post-fix no-threading DM behavior to remain the only supported app-auth DM path.

recommendation.title: Decide config API first
recommendation.body: Choose the accepted config surface before merge, then require the branch to update exported types, generated metadata, docs, and live proof for that shape.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the prior DM suppression fix, maintainer verification, and adjacent Google Chat thread support.
